tasks.short: Teach personal development and self-advocacy skills

steps.what: Review actual pupil goals and select appropriate personal-development examples
Teach goal setting, independence and self-advocacy through actual pupil practice

tasks.design: Keep goal-specific preparation in {LMS} and {DOCS} and the teacher's direct personal-development instruction. Native pupil-goal access already supplies context here; a template cannot practice independence or self-advocacy for the child.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personal development requires responsive instruction and actual pupil practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native materials support preparation without establishing a removable repeated operation.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing an achievable challenge and supporting the pupil without taking over.
tasks.human_edge: Help the individual pupil build confidence and independent action.
tasks.altitude: No change to personal-development teaching responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: teaching independence and self-advocacy requires direct practice and contextual teacher support; a separate class-progress log is not inherent to every lesson.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is one prepared teaching encounter using actual existing goals, not creating a formal pupil plan. Goal production is existing separately owned teaching work; reading and selection remain counted here.

Before zero, inspect material lookup, preparation, pupil-plan writing, required progress entries and sends. Native access is already direct and no separate output is established for this encounter. Any actual required record must be separately counted once in the records workflow before roll-up, not treated as nonexistent.
No new pupil-progress log, transcript or score is introduced. No repeated navigation baseline is assumed, and no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written goal or progress-update duty in the lesson
research_questions: Observe a personal-development lesson and identify any real preparation or written update beyond the counted review.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 15 goal-review/preparation and 85 teaching/practice points. A new independence goal still requires personal selection and direct support; no established duplicate record or send is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish and communicate clear learning objectives

steps.what: Establish appropriate lesson, unit and project objectives for the actual pupils
Copy exact descriptions and references for the teacher-selected curriculum goal codes
Write clear pupil-facing objective wording for the actual lessons and projects

loop.purpose: Restate selected objectives in teacher-specified accessible language
loop.input: Teacher-selected objectives, goal references and language/access constraints
loop.output: Draft pupil-facing objectives with original-goal references
loop.check: Teacher checks unchanged learning demand, accessibility, omitted limits and mapping to the intended objective
loop.stop: Altered learning demand, missing goal or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native goal descriptions come first; adapting wording for actual pupils requires bounded drafting and teacher review

steps.what: Check complete objective wording and its suitability for these pupils
Communicate the objectives directly and check pupils understand what they will learn

tasks.design: Test native curriculum-code lookup in {LMS} to remove repeated reference copying. A bounded draft in {DOCS} restates the teacher's selected objectives for the pupils; the teacher retains goal choice, complete checks and direct communication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selecting appropriate goals is mixed with repeated reference copying and accessible restatement.
tasks.enabler_now: Exact-code lookup and bounded wording adaptation can assist without setting a child's learning level.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing meaningful, achievable objectives and knowing whether pupils understand them.
tasks.human_edge: Set and explain suitable learning intentions for the actual children.
tasks.altitude: Less reference copying with unchanged objective-setting authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact curriculum-code lookup can reuse descriptions; wording drafts require teacher checks to preserve learning demand and accessibility.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a workflow with manual reference copying. The curriculum owner maintains goal ID, description and version; the teacher selects codes and objectives in s1. No model assigns pupil level or chooses a goal.

Native lookup comes first. Missing codes and changed descriptions return to manual selection/checking in s1/s4. Only 15 reference-copying points and 4 of 20 wording-restatement points are removed; input, specialist wording, repair and full checks remain.

This is actual objective preparation and communication, not a new progress log. Existing lookup runtime earns no credit. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained and ungated; direct pupil communication remains human.
No transcript or new capture duty is assumed. More mapping or wording repair than retained requires a lower estimate.
unknowns: Existing goal-list support and actual copying share
research_questions: Prepare objectives for one real unit and check whether adapted wording preserves the teacher's intended learning demand.

incremental.description: Maintain goal-version mappings and objective-draft checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 15 copying and 4 wording points less 1 upkeep. A new individualized unit has few standard goal links; reuse only 2 points of exact references and 1 of accessible restatement: 3 minus 1 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Guide pupils with adjustment or academic concerns

steps.what: Read actual pupil work and context for the adjustment or academic concern
Guide or counsel pupils about adjustment, academic problems or special academic interests

tasks.design: Retain actual work reading in {LMS} and {DOCS} and personal guidance of the pupil. Existing native context access is already direct; a generic summary does not replace understanding this child's concern.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective guidance depends on the actual pupil, work and relationship.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil-work access supports preparation without establishing a removable repeated operation here.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising the concern and choosing a safe, suitable response.
tasks.human_edge: Listen sensitively and adjust support to the individual child.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pupil guidance requires contextual work review and responsive personal interaction; a separate activity log is not inherent to each conversation.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is a guidance encounter, not a formal referral or written assessment. Existing pupil work is produced in normal learning; the teacher's reading stays counted.

Before zero, inspect preparation, lookup, support-plan amendments, required notes and parent/referral sends. Native work access is already direct and no separate written output is established here. Add actual required documentation once in its records workflow and separately gate any real send before estimating that broader workflow.
No new guidance log, transcript or pupil score is introduced. No repetitive navigation baseline is assumed, and no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual formal written guidance or referral duties
research_questions: Observe pupil guidance and identify any actual support-plan amendment, note or parent communication.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 20 work/context-reading and 80 guidance points. A difficult adjustment concern still needs full personal understanding; no actual duplicated record or send is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and conduct a balanced program of learning activities

steps.what: Verify pupil access needs, available time and intended learning opportunities
Design instruction, demonstration and work activities with time to observe and investigate
Write the actual activity instructions and teaching plan

loop.purpose: Restate the teacher's selected activity instructions
loop.input: Selected activities, exact sequence, access constraints and teacher-authored teaching intent
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, missing assistance, accessibility, time demands and that observation and investigation opportunities remain intact
loop.stop: Unsupported activity, omitted access need or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native plan headings come first; variable instructions for actual pupils need bounded drafting

steps.what: Lay out the selected sequence and calculate its exact time allocations
Check the complete activity program, balance and practical accessibility
Conduct the program and support pupils' observing, questioning and investigating

tasks.design: Use native timed-plan layouts in {LMS} before custom code, retaining the teacher's choices of activities, sequence and durations. A bounded draft in {DOCS} assists instruction wording; the teacher checks the full balanced program and conducts the actual learning activities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity planning mixes pedagogical choices with repeated instruction restatement and time layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native time fields and bounded drafting can assist explicit decisions without designing pupil learning autonomously.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing methods and access needs while preserving genuine pupil investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and adjust activities for actual pupil engagement and learning.
tasks.altitude: Less plan layout and instruction restatement with unchanged pedagogical authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning-plan layouts can calculate selected durations and bounded drafts can restate teacher-selected activities; pedagogical balance remains teacher judgement.

assumptions: Provisional scenario is a planning-heavy cycle with an existing teaching plan used to conduct activities. A delivery-heavy or planning-only assignment requires reweighting. No class-progress log or new pupil score is introduced.

The teacher verifies pupil needs and supplies activity IDs, exact sequence, durations, materials and assistance requirements in s1-s3. Input, fresh activity design and missing details remain counted; no free ready-made activity specification is assumed.

Native layouts come first. Remove only 10 repeated time-layout/arithmetic points and 3 of 20 instruction-restatement points. s3/s5 retain substantive writing, full checks, missing-detail repair and ordinary save. Higher repair effort lowers savings.
No model chooses the balance or learning demand. Existing automatic schedule runtime earns no credit and ordinary author saves are ungated. No separate external publication or message is assumed.
unknowns: Actual planning/delivery balance and native time-layout support
research_questions: Prepare a real balanced program and count instruction corrections, access omissions and manual time layout.

incremental.description: Maintain timed-plan fields and instruction-draft checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 10 layout and 3 restatement points less 1 upkeep. Unusual access arrangements need bespoke instructions and sequencing; reuse only 2 points of ordinary time totals and 0.8 routine wording: 2.8 minus 1 = 1.8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain direct development teaching, guidance and pedagogical choices while reducing explicit curriculum copying and activity-plan layout.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous pupil-level setting or new classroom record requirement is proposed.
